formal: I injured my knee while running and have been performing physiotherapy exercises for three weeks. The pain has subsided within the last few days. The plan is to discontinue the physiotherapy exercises and resume my usual 10k runs next week. I have no means of assessing knee exercises or running distances, so I will proceed with this plan without making a decision of my own. Asking you about my running or my knee is unusual for me, and I rarely bring decisions to you. What is your view?
